name: ModelVariant159_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant159_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a rainbow curtain rises from the floor, waves and slides to the other slot, then glowing prisms grow along its edge); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request modulo 100, builds the curtain points, packs the texture images and prints the work size, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the curtain falls, 4 while it falls, then 1 once and 2; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-176 and 306 images build it without the work-size printf, so their data names bind 0x24 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
